adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb, perform_retrieve does call `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline (inside `if SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?`). That directly reuses a scheduled job class as a synchronous dependency rather than isolating the feed polling logic behind a service object. While this isn’t a provable correctness bug from the diff alone, it is a concrete architecture/performance concern introduced by the change (job composition, coupling, and potentially long-running work via feed polling). The claim that it runs in a “web-triggered path” is only indirectly true: EmbedController enqueues `:retrieve_topic` (a background job), which then calls TopicRetriever; it’s not executed in-request, but it is triggered by a web request.
